card1_example: Partners at scaling tax firms evaluating AI tax software this quarter
card1_body: A firm doesn't switch tax software because an ad caught a partner mid-scroll. They switch when a workflow breaks and they go searching. These channels also need huge audiences, and 'firms evaluating AI tax tools right now' is too small a slice to target.
card4_body: The only channel that scores green on the requirement that matters most: it puts SignalsHQ in front of a firm the moment a partner types the problem into Google.
